## Installations & Imports

```{r}
# Install Packages
#install.packages(pkgs = c("tidyverse","SmartEDA","plyr","knitr","flextable","gtsummary","dlookr","moments","dplyr","officer", "cardx"))

# Libraries & Imports
packages <- c("tidyverse","SmartEDA","plyr","knitr","flextable","gtsummary","dlookr","moments","dplyr","officer", "cardx", "gt")
invisible(lapply(X = packages, FUN = library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))
```

## Reading Data

```{r}
# Load BAF Data
baf <- read.csv("Base.csv")

# New table with a subset of columns
baf_subset <- baf[, c("fraud_bool", "income", "customer_age", "credit_risk_score", "name_email_similarity", "proposed_credit_limit", "session_length_in_minutes", "payment_type", "housing_status", "employment_status", "device_os")]
```

## Summarizing Continuous Variables

```{r}
# Summarize continuous variables
baf_diag <- diagnose_numeric(baf_subset)

# Calculate skewness and kurtosis for each variable
extra_stats <- lapply(baf_diag$variable, function(varname) {
  vec <- baf_subset[[varname]]
  
  list(
    skewness = if (is.numeric(vec)) moments::skewness(vec, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
    kurtosis = if (is.numeric(vec)) moments::kurtosis(vec, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
  )
})

# Add variables to baf_diag summary table
extra_stats_df <- bind_rows(extra_stats)
baf_diag_full <- bind_cols(baf_diag, extra_stats_df)

# Round to 2 decimal places
baf_diag_full[] <- lapply(baf_diag_full, function(x) {
  if(is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x
})

# Remove "outlier" variable
baf_diag_full <- baf_diag_full %>%
  select(-outlier)

# Future formatting
num_cols <- c("min","Q1","mean","median","Q3", "max", "zero", "minus", "skewness", "kurtosis")
```

```{r}
# Display final summary table
baf_diag_full %>% 
  flextable() %>%
  set_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Continuous Variables") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "header") %>%
  add_footer_lines("Note: fraud_bool is the target variable which is heavily skewed. Appoximately 99% of records belong to the negative class (Non-Fraud)") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = num_cols, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  border_inner_h(part = "body", border = fp_border(color = "gray", width = 0.5))
```

## Summarizing Categorical Variables

```{r}
# Summarize categorical variables
baf_subset %>%
  select(fraud_bool, payment_type, housing_status) %>%
  tbl_summary(by= fraud_bool) %>%
  modify_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Categorical Variables")
```

```{r}
# Summarize categorical variables continued

baf_subset %>%
  select(fraud_bool, employment_status, device_os) %>%
  tbl_summary(by= fraud_bool)%>%
  modify_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Categorical Variables")
```
